label: Lakewood

county_election_office.name: Jefferson County Elections, 3500 Illinois St., Suite 1100, Golden 80401

zip_caveats: 80214 also covers Edgewater and part of Wheat Ridge and Denver; 80215 includes Wheat Ridge; 80227 and 80235 include unincorporated Jeffco (Bear Creek, Fort Logan area) and a bit of Denver; 80401 is mostly Golden and unincorporated Jeffco with a slice of west Lakewood; 80123 touches southeast Lakewood, Bow Mar and Littleton. Congressional district is CD-7 for most of Lakewood, with CD-1 covering a small eastern edge near Sheridan Blvd. State legislative and RTD districts vary by address. All Lakewood voters see city questions 2G to 2J, Jeffco Schools 5A and 5B, the Jeffco commissioner race, West Metro Fire 7C (most of the city) and rail 7A.
